technical_analysis.symptom: 未提供数字 and MA5[path] in technical analysis output

ma5_path_bug.mechanism: If LLM generates any text containing patterns like '/ma/5' (e.g., from code references or format artifacts), the regex matches it as an absolute Unix path and replaces with '[path]'
ma5_path_bug.result: MA5[path] or similar in final output

unsupported_number_bug.root_cause_2: specialist_analysis_utils.py:93-94 — if not allowed: return _NUMERIC_RE.sub('未提供数字', text)
unsupported_number_bug.critical_condition: When evidence_text is empty or allowed set is empty, ALL numbers in text are replaced
unsupported_number_bug.regex_issue: _NUMERIC_RE = r'(?<![A-Za-z])[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?%?' matches individual digit groups within dates and codes
unsupported_number_bug.date_breaking: Date '2026-07-28' → _NUMERIC_RE matches '2026', '07', '28' as separate tokens; any not in evidence → replaced with '未提供数字' → '未提供数字-未提供数字-未提供数字'
unsupported_number_bug.code_breaking: Stock code '600519' → matches '600519'; if not in evidence_text → '未提供数字'

evidence_text_problem.analysis: user_content (evidence_text) is the technical analyst prompt. The prompt contains MA5 value (e.g., '1255.19') and dates. If the LLM's output numbers don't exactly match the prompt numbers (e.g., precision differences or derived values), they are unsupported.
evidence_text_problem.date_format_comparison: Prompt uses YYYY-MM-DD; if LLM outputs YYYYMMDD or different format, no match → 未提供数字
